shared_elements: incised script-like signs arranged in linear registers or columns
small schematic human/figural forms in low relief
framing border along the edge of the field
justification: Both surfaces are upright inscribed slabs bearing rows or columns of small incised sign-like marks with schematic figural elements, rendered in shallow low relief, which is a loose but real correspondence in how the field is organized. However, A shows a fully legible scheme — a round-topped lunette with figures raising their arms toward a rayed disc above many horizontal lines of text — whereas B shows only a narrow strip of signs along one edge with a large undecorated central field and no comparable adoration scene, disc, or register block.
